metadata.title: Surrealist Stone Bust with Serpentine Crown

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, grainy monochrome image of a classical cherub bust, where the hair is replaced by realistic coiled snakes. A vibrant, glossy emerald green liquid splash cuts diagonally across the face, while stylized black lettering is tattooed across the chest.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the matte stone texture and the high-gloss liquid splash.
Juxtaposition of innocent cherubic features with predatory serpentine elements.
Symmetry of the bust against the asymmetrical, dynamic movement of the green drip.
coreInvariants: Heavy film grain and noise throughout the composition.
Desaturated grayscale palette for the subject and background.
Single, saturated accent color (Emerald Green) for the liquid element.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered, medium-close shot of a bust from the chest up, filling approximately 70% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The cherub's face, partially obscured by the green splash.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-right green splash, follows the diagonal drip across the face to the bottom-left, then settles on the chest lettering.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Solid black, textured background providing high contrast for the light-colored stone.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black and dark gray (Background and shadows).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Light gray and white (Stone bust highlights).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme contrast between a completely desaturated subject and a highly saturated, mid-value accent.

letterConstructionRules: Variable stroke widths with a hand-drawn, ink-bleed quality.
Letters follow the contour of the bust's collarbone area.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Terminals are sharp and pointed like shards.

composition.position: Lower third, left and right corners

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Aggressive, custom central lettering paired with minimalist, wide-tracked secondary sans-serif.

preserve: The arched placement on the chest
The sharp, angular nature of the main text

candidateDirections.reason: For the secondary corner text to maintain a modern, clean contrast.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A monochrome, grainy photo of a stone cherub bust with snakes for hair against a black background. A glossy, vibrant emerald green liquid splash is frozen in mid-air, dripping diagonally across the face from top-right to bottom-left.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply custom, sharp-angled black lettering in an arched shape across the chest of the bust, ensuring it looks like a tattoo. Add wide-spaced, small green sans-serif text in the bottom left and right corners.

verificationChecks: Is the green splash glossy and vibrant against the matte stone?
Does the chest text follow the physical curvature of the bust?
Is the overall image covered in a consistent, heavy film grain?
Are the snakes integrated seamlessly into the head of the bust?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the green splash does not look like a flat overlay but has depth and highlights.
Check that the grain doesn't obscure the sharp details of the snake scales.
Verify the text tracking in the corners is sufficiently wide to feel modern.
Confirm the bust's lighting matches the environment's dark atmosphere.
recipe.reuseFormula: Classical sculpture + biological anomaly (snakes/insects) + dynamic liquid accent + high-contrast monochrome + aggressive custom typography.
